package.name: auro_gz_plugins
package.description: Gazebo (gz-sim) plugins for the AURO assessment, each its own library: gz_link_attacher, a system that attaches a link of its model to a link of any other model at runtime with a fixed joint, and detaches it again (the crane's winch); gz_model_carrier, a system that makes its model carry another model rigidly, by setting that model's pose on every simulation step, and puts it down again (the robot's end effectors); WinchCable, a GUI plugin that draws the cable between the crane's winch block and winch. See the comment at the top of each source file for how to use it.
